notes.title: Update announcement (full cross-platform, F2P/P2P editions, artbook, s/t, new units)
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018499/523084f06cd0e801bf84ac59d76a4bae3ff5c443.png[/img]

Hello, everyone!

It's been far more than a year since Warbands:Bushido launched to Steam Early Access, so it's time to make a few tough decisions and fix some mistakes we've made.

As you can see, current progress on Steam version is a bit stale. It's not only because we had to change focus to Android, which took us an incredible amount of work, but also because of some technical issues with updating all 3 versions at once. And it looks like we've finally solved the problem.

So the new full-cross platform server is coming, with at least a few hundred players online on all 3 current platforms. Plus there will be 2 versions of Steam client: payed and free2play. Since the game will have unified client, [b]players who have payed for their versions will get a special subscriptions with daily coin and dust rewards.[/b]

Plus players will be able to share progress with devices on other platforms, without requesting a transfer on forums. Now there is an interface for it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27018499/aff7ad322c7041aa10bb2b5c29489409d9d94ddf.png[/img]

To test the new updates system Monks will be added to your boosters, which you will be able to buy with an in-game coins via in-app purchases both.

Update will be available in a couple of weeks, so feel free to write us what you think about all that in a comments bellow.


Thank you for playing Warbands!
Red Unit Studios team


PS. Not sure if it's wise decision, but there's another announcement incoming. It's about one of 2 projects we're working on. And it's another Warbands game. Coming soon..
